investigation_summary.title: AURA Copilot Tool-Calling Pipeline Root Cause Analysis
investigation_summary.scope: Hard-coded entity names, raw tool-call display, entity resolution failures

root_causes.title: Silent Entity Fallback in _resolve_entity()
root_causes.description: When LLM generates entity_name that doesn't match any CRM entity, _resolve_entity() silently returns entities[0] instead of None or raising an error
root_causes.code_snippet: # Line 54: return entities[0]  # Should return None
root_causes.impact: Records created in wrong entities; data goes to first entity regardless of user intent
root_causes.example_scenario: User: 'Add a lead' → CRM has only 'machine_identifier' entity → Record created in machine_identifier instead of suggesting clarification
required_changes: Return None instead of entities[0] when no match found
Caller must handle None and ask user for clarification or list available entities

root_causes.title: Hardcoded Example Entity Names in System Prompt
root_causes.description: System prompt contains hardcoded examples using 'lead', 'customer', 'contact' without reflecting actual CRM entities
root_causes.code_snippet: "Examples:\n- Create record: TOOL_CALL: {...entity_name: lead...}\n- Update: ...entity_name: lead..."
root_causes.impact: LLM learns these are valid entity names from examples; generates them even if they don't exist in the CRM
root_causes.example_scenario: CRM with only 'product' entity; LLM sees 'lead' examples and generates entity_name='lead' which doesn't exist
required_changes: Replace hardcoded examples with examples using actual CRM entity names
Dynamically generate 'VALID ENTITY NAMES: ...' section from config
Add instruction: 'Always use entity names from the VALID ENTITY NAMES list above'

root_causes.title: Missing Explicit Entity List in CRM Context
root_causes.description: ACTIVE CRM CONTEXT section includes entity fields but not a clear machine-identifier list for LLM to parse
root_causes.impact: LLM must infer valid entity names from semi-structured text; lacks definitive list for tool-call generation
root_causes.example_scenario: LLM reads entity_summary but doesn't have explicit list like 'VALID ENTITIES: machine_identifier, product'
required_changes: Add explicit section: 'VALID ENTITY NAMES: comma-separated-list'
Include entity labels in parentheses for clarity: 'machine_identifier (Machine ID), product (Product Item)'
Emphasize that LLM must only use names from this list

root_causes.title: No Entity Validation Before Tool Execution
root_causes.description: execute_tool_call endpoint accepts entity_name without validating it exists in CRM configuration
root_causes.code_snippet: result = handler(crm_id=body.crm_id, owner_id=str(user_id), **body.arguments)  # No entity validation before handler call
root_causes.impact: Invalid entity names reach handler; handler's fallback (RC-001) silently uses wrong entity
root_causes.example_scenario: Frontend sends entity_name='lead' to execute_tool_call → No validation → Handler falls back to first entity
required_changes: Before calling handler, fetch CRM and validate entity_name exists
Return 404 with available entity list if entity not found
Log all validation failures for debugging

root_causes.title: Incomplete Regex for Tool-Call Parsing
root_causes.description: Regex pattern for TOOL_CALL parsing: /TOOL_CALL:\s*(\{[^{}]*(?:\{[^{}]*\}[^{}]*)*\})/g only handles ~2 levels of nesting
root_causes.impact: Fails on moderately complex tool calls; unparsed markers are not removed, appear as raw JSON in UI
root_causes.example_scenario: LLM generates: TOOL_CALL: {...data: {nested: {value: 123}}...} → Regex fails → cleanToolCallMarkers() doesn't remove marker → User sees raw JSON
required_changes: Replace regex with iterative JSON parser (find 'TOOL_CALL:' then parse JSON from that position)
Add try/catch to cleanToolCallMarkers to gracefully handle parsing failures
Never display unparseable markers to users

root_causes.title: No Pre-Validation of LLM-Generated Arguments
root_causes.description: _universal_action_reply() generates tool calls with entity_name via fuzzy matching; no validation that matched entity exists
root_causes.code_snippet: target_entity_name = target_entity['name'] if target_entity else primary_entity_name  # May reference non-existent entity
root_causes.impact: Tool calls generated with potentially invalid entity names if entity resolution is uncertain
root_causes.example_scenario: Fuzzy match fails; code defaults to 'primary_entity_name' which may not match any real entity
required_changes: Always validate that resolved entity_name exists in config.entities
Return error or clarification request if validation fails
Log fuzzy-match failures

root_causes.title: Missing Required-Field Collection Workflow
root_causes.description: create_record tool doesn't collect missing required fields before execution; backend validation errors reported to user without guidance
root_causes.code_snippet: No pre-collection of required fields; tool call generated with whatever data can be extracted from user message
root_causes.impact: Poor UX: user receives validation errors instead of being asked for missing fields in conversation
root_causes.example_scenario: User: 'Add John' → CRM requires name, email, phone → Tool call sent with only name → Backend validation fails → User must resubmit
required_changes: Before generating create_record tool call, analyze required fields
If required fields missing, generate response asking user for those fields
Preserve context across multiple messages to build complete record

root_causes.title: Raw Tool-Call Display When Parsing Fails
root_causes.description: If cleanToolCallMarkers() fails to remove markers (due to regex failure), raw TOOL_CALL JSON is displayed as part of AI message
root_causes.code_snippet: const displayText = cleanToolCallMarkers(res.reply);  // May contain TOOL_CALL markers if cleanToolCallMarkers() fails
root_causes.impact: Users see JSON fragments in conversation, breaking natural-language experience
root_causes.example_scenario: LLM reply: 'I've prepared... TOOL_CALL: {...}' → Regex fails → displayText still contains marker → User sees it
required_changes: Improve cleanToolCallMarkers() to handle parsing failures gracefully
Never display raw tool-call markers to users; strip them even if parsing fails
If tool call unparseable, log warning and hide marker entirely

issues: No pre-validation; accepts entity_name without schema check

current_flow: Backend: No dynamic entity list in prompt; hardcoded 'lead' examples
Frontend: Regex fails (complex JSON); marker not removed
Backend: No validation; passes to handler
Handler: _resolve_entity('lead') → NOT FOUND → returns entities[0] (wrong entity)
Backend: Creates record in WRONG entity
Frontend: User sees raw TOOL_CALL marker if regex failed
required_flow: Backend: System prompt includes 'VALID ENTITY NAMES: [actual entities]'
LLM: Sees actual entities; generates tool call with valid entity_name
Frontend: Improved parser removes tool-call markers or asks for confirmation
Frontend: Calls execute_tool_call with valid entity_name
Backend: Validates entity_name exists in CRM
Handler: _resolve_entity() returns correct entity or None (error)
Backend: Creates record in CORRECT entity
Frontend: User sees clean confirmation, no raw JSON

Copilot never generates tool calls with invalid entity names
Backend validates entity names before tool execution
Raw TOOL_CALL JSON never appears in user conversations
Missing required fields collected via natural conversation
No regression in existing Copilot functionality
Error messages are clear and actionable
